_comment: Ranked source catalog. rank 1 = best for an autonomous agent (quality x agent-readability x licence clarity). `search` has {q} (URL-encoded) or {slug} (hyphenated); `fetch` is the first Scrapling tier (get -> fetch -> stealth). Generated docs: references/SOURCES-CATALOG.md (node scripts/sources.mjs docs). Validate with: node scripts/sources.mjs check.
